deviations.description: Phase 3's Verification bullet: "Manual: after a forced round completes, a --dry-run re-check shows the task under -- Blocked -- with the new reason."
deviations.reason: Confirmed by direct read of orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh (~line 468): --dry-run unconditionally never reads the persisted mt_state_file, regardless of whether --session matches a prior live run (pre-existing design, already documented by Group 21 Case C's comment in test-orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh: "--dry-run never persists force_phases_remaining across invocations by design"). So a --dry-run call cannot literally observe forced_round_seeded/force_phases_remaining state left by a prior LIVE call under the same session -- verified this manually (live forced round, then --dry-run re-check with the same session showed ordinary status-derived routing, not blocked). The mechanism this phase fixes (stop after the last forced phase) is inherently a LIVE-path concern anyway (no lock/dispatch file/status write/cycle charge -- all LIVE-only side effects), and is exhaustively covered by LIVE-to-LIVE fixture cases in test-orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh's Group 4/5 and test-force-phases.sh's new section. Verified the manual check via a second LIVE call instead, which does show the blocked[] row.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — manual verification performed via a second LIVE call, not --dry-run, since --dry-run never reads persisted mt_state_file by pre-existing design; automated LIVE-to-LIVE fixture coverage is unaffected and exhaustive)*
